name: CMOS 4-by-4 NOR mask ROM
description: Four precharge PMOS devices, nine hard-wired NMOS cells and four output inverters implement a 4-by-4 NOR mask ROM, for twenty-one MOS devices. The words are 0xA, 0x6, 0xD, 0x3; b0 is the least-significant bit. A present pulldown cell stores 1. With preb low all word lines must be low; after precharge, preb rises and one word line selects a word. Four 100 fF bitline capacitors retain the dynamic state. The saved test checks all 16 read bits plus four precharge outputs. No address decoder is hidden: w0–w3 are external one-hot word lines. Educational nominal models; no retention-time, read-margin, glitch or PVT guarantee.
